text:
THE KENYA NATIONAL EXAMINATIONS COUNCIL
 SCHOOL BASED ASSESSMENT
 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
 GRADE 6-2022
 MARKING GUIDE & SCORING RUBRICS
 (For Regular Learners)
 Turn Over
1. Plant tress/ collect rubbish/ clean environment.
2. Unemployment/ joblessness/ loss of jobs/ collapse of business/ lack of money/
 basic needs.
3. Playing keyboard/ leading songs/ worship/entertainment (and any other relevant
 answer).
4. Tom- Visited an old man.
5. Be active in church/ Obey the Bible/ pray for their lives/ Avoid bad company/
 Avoid getting into boy/girl relationships/ Avoid premarital sex.
6. Joshua- Old Testament.
7. Respect your father and mother.
8. Repent your sins/ change/ Turn away from bad behaviour/ share wealth with the
 needy/ share meals with friends/ relatives/ neighbors.
9. King Solomon/ Solomon.
10. Deliver Israelites from slavery/ bondage in Egypt.
11. To have faith in God/ To help people in trouble/ To help others/ To co-operate with
 others.
12. Angel Gabriel/ Gabriel.
13. Do not accuse anyone falsely.
14. Sign of repentance/ forgiveness of sins/ To show they accept to become followers
 of Jesus/ starting new life with Jesus/ casting old life/ obey teachings of the Bible.
15. Wise/ intelligent/ courageous.
16. The healing of Ten Lepers.
17. To seek help/ To be persistent/ To have faith in God/ Not to allow other people to
 discourage you when doing the right thing.
18. The kingdom of God grows from a small beginning/ from a small beginning, the
 kingdom of God grows to become very big.
19. Persist in your prayer until you get what you need/ Do not give up in prayer.
20. God’s kingdom to be established on earth/ Ask for forgiveness from God/ ask
 God’s provision/ daily bread/ protection/ deliverance from evil.
21. List M- Shared a cup of wine/ Gave thanks.
22. Be ready to suffer for Christ/ Forgive your enemies/ Have faith in God.
23. Sharing their food/ pens/pencils/ assist a sick child (and any other relevant answer).
24. Love/ peace/ self- control/ goodness.
25. Truthfulness/ honesty.
26. Responsibility/ love/ respect.
27. Avoid bad company/ remain in school until the end of the day/ what he/she is
 doing is wrong/ obey the rules of the school (and any other relevant response).
28. Tell him to seek advice from responsible adults/ parents/ teachers/ church leaders/
 read materials on coping with developmental changes/ watch Christian films/
 videos on developmental changes during adolescence/ advise him to accept/ have a
 positive attitude towards developmental changes.
29. Check that no vehicle/ motorbike/ bicycle is moving on the road before crossing/
 do not engage in other activities as you cross/ use a footbridge when crossing a
 busy road/ get assistance when crossing the road.
